name: LAST SEEN
source:
LAST SEEN is a psychological romance visual novel about Noah and the people he grows close to
what starts as a grounded story about relationships texting friendship and love slowly turns into psychological meta horror as memories change people disappear and the game itself begins behaving strangely
translation:
《最后上线》（LAST SEEN）是一款心理恋爱视觉小说，聚焦于诺亚以及与他日渐亲近的人们。
故事起初围绕人际关系、短信聊天、友情与爱恋展开，平实而贴近生活；然而随着记忆遭到篡改、身边的人接连消失，乃至游戏本身也开始出现诡异的异常举动，一切正悄然滑向心理元恐怖的深渊。
